about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Gabe Amo

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SHOP LOCAL AND SUPPORT SMALL BUSINESSES
statements.title: SHOP LOCAL AND SUPPORT SMALL BUSINESSES
sentences: They want an economy that works for all Americans, but Trump's tariffs, illegal war with Iran, ICE cruelty, and corruption are driving up costs and putting pressure on household budgets and small businesses as we head into the holiday season.
It is past time to end Trump's tariffs and illegal war with Iran.
If you can, shop local and support a small business, and I will keep fighting in Congress to make life more affordable. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MANDATE FOR CHANGE
statements.title: MANDATE FOR CHANGE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, the people have spoken, and they want the Iran war over and accountability for the leaders who led us down this costly path.
When given the chance to stand with the people, they once again chose to stand with Trump, his illegal war of choice with Iran, and more chaos and more confusion.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORTING EARLY-CHILDHOOD EDUCATORS' DEDUCTIONS ACT
statements.title: SUPPORTING EARLY-CHILDHOOD EDUCATORS' DEDUCTIONS ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, Russia invaded Ukraine.
Vladimir Putin is waging an illegal war against a democratic nation.
Russia should be sanctioned, and Ukraine should be supported, but this bill is not the way to do it.
President Trump already can sanction Russia and the companies, individuals, and vessels funding Putin's war machine.
He has chosen not to use that authority, so that means he has had ample opportunity to support Ukraine, but he chooses not to.
What this bill does is give Trump sweeping new power to impose tariffs.

That means it is: power to hike prices on Americans with more erratic tariffs; power to hurt economic growth with more erratic tariffs; and power to further destroy our alliances with more erratic tariffs.
Trump already thinks he has power to impose tariffs on anyone and everything.
On so-called liberation day, he hiked illegal tariffs worldwide, including on a remote island of penguins.
Where is the one place he didn't tariff?
That irony is not lost on me and the Rhode Islanders know who pays for Trump's tariffs: We do.
The last thing Rhode Islanders need is another Trump tariff driving up the cost of groceries, energy, and everyday goods.
We can stand with Ukraine without giving President Trump another weapon to raise prices on American families.
We already passed the Ukraine Support Act, a thoughtful bill that both supported Ukraine and sanctioned Russia.
That is the kind of legislation we need to punish Putin, stand with Ukraine, and protect families.
Mr. Speaker, I urge a ``no'' vote.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FOREIGN SERVICE MODERNIZATION ACT
statements.title: FOREIGN SERVICE MODERNIZATION ACT
sentences: The administration foolishly eliminated a number of key bureaus and offices, including the Energy Bureau and its experts, who tracked Russia, China, and Iran's use of oil as a weapon.

Secretary Rubio claimed that this reduction in force was in support of both merit-based hiring and that his department reorganization helped eliminate redundant functions that were no longer necessary.
Madam Speaker, I rise today in support of H.R. 9086, the Foreign Service Modernization Act, as amended.
The American people are entitled to answers, and we will continue asking questions.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LABOR DAY
statements.title: LABOR DAY
sentences: Now, building on that legacy, I stand with Rhode Island workers and workers across our country to keep fighting for good jobs, fair wages, safe workplaces, and the right to organize.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REBUILDING USAID
statements.title: REBUILDING USAID
sentences: Mr. Speaker, 19 months ago, President Trump took an axe to our foreign assistance, illegally freezing aid and demolishing the United States Agency for International Development.

Thirteen days later, he ranted that USAID was ``run by a bunch of radical lunatics.'' The very next day, Elon Musk bragged that DOGE had ``spent the weekend feeding USAID into the wood chipper.'' Well, the chips fell, and kids died.
Abdullahi Ibrahim was 10 years old when USAID-supported asthma treatment disappeared from his clinic in Nigeria.
He died of malaria after clinics in western Liberia ran out of malaria medication because of USAID cuts.
Abdullahi, Mohammed, and Gbessy are three of the more than 700,000 no longer with us because of Trump's choice to close USAID and decimate U.S. foreign assistance programs.
In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, cuts to USAID-funded disease-detection systems delayed detection and response to the Ebola outbreak.
Shuttering USAID eliminated more than 23,000 American jobs.
American farmers and manufacturers who supply food products to USAID were left struggling.
Cuts to USAID disease monitoring and prevention systems leave Americans at greater risk of disease.
Our foreign assistance was never charity.
As the USAID logo reminded the world, it was from the American people.
We must rebuild American foreign assistance, restore American leadership, hold accountable those who recklessly dismantle these programs, and remember every single life that was lost.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SNAP ASSISTANCE RIPPED AWAY
statements.title: SNAP ASSISTANCE RIPPED AWAY
sentences: In Rhode Island alone, that is over 16,000 people who are now heading to the grocery store with less to spend as costs rise because of Trump's tariffs and illegal wars.
In the wealthiest country in the world, no one should have to worry about putting food on the table.
We can do better than Trump's foreign wars and putting billionaires over the welfare of working people. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
statements.title: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
sentences: Republicans are trying to pass another bad budget, and all this for the farm aid that Republicans are touting as necessary because Trump's illegal war in Iran and chaotic tariffs jacked up costs for farmers.

The billions in defense funding that Republicans claim is necessary for Trump's choice to wage the illegal Iran war depleted our stockpiles, and the only necessary action that my constituents are imploring Republicans to take, lowering costs for the American people, is completely missing from this failing effort.
I urge every Member to vote ``no'' on this latest bad budget.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF STATE, AND RELATED PROGRAMS APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
statements.title: NATIONAL SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF STATE, AND RELATED PROGRAMS APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
sentences: Ban the United States from supporting the World Health Organization, the group coordinating the response to the Ebola outbreak.

My amendment would strike provisions that prohibit U.S. participation in international public health efforts through the World Health Organization and the pandemic prevention, preparedness, and response accord.
Mr. Chair, I rise in opposition to H.R. 8595.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BRISTOL FOURTH OF JULY
statements.title: BRISTOL FOURTH OF JULY
sentences: By the time the town welcomes as many as 200,000 visitors to its community, the town committee, the police department, the fire department, and the Fourth of July committee have worked around the clock for months to pull off a safe and spectacular event.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRUMP CORRUPTION OUT OF CONTROL
statements.title: TRUMP CORRUPTION OUT OF CONTROL
sentences: Multiple Cabinet members have conveniently sold stocks right before one of Trump's erratic tariff announcements.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TIME TO BRING DOWN COSTS
statements.title: TIME TO BRING DOWN COSTS
sentences: Republicans can always find money for billionaires, but how is it they can't find money for moms and babies?

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SECURE AMERICA ACT
statements.title: SECURE AMERICA ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, when I first heard the bill's name, I thought somebody said: less Secure America Act.
This latest scheme is about pouring $70 billion into ICE and CBP while leaving untouched Trump's $1.8 billion slush fund for his political allies and January 6 cop beaters.
It does nothing to lower costs, nothing to stop corruption, and nothing to help working families.
If you are worried about affording childcare, Republicans have nothing for you.
Mr. Speaker, I urge a ``no'' vote on Republicans' latest betrayal.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRUMP IS STEALING YOUR MONEY
statements.title: TRUMP IS STEALING YOUR MONEY
sentences: At every turn, he is taking money from Americans' bank accounts to pad his pockets and those of his billionaire buddies.
His tariffs, which were twice ruled illegal, cost the average working family of four $1,700 last year.
At the gas pump, Americans have collectively paid an extra $40 billion to fuel up since the start of this war of choice with Iran.
It is an over $1.7 billion taxpayer-funded slush fund to pay off his cronies who have been convicted of crimes, including the dangerous felons who attacked the Capitol on January 6.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING SNAP
statements.title: PROTECTING SNAP
sentences: At a time when Republicans' tariffs and wars have jacked up grocery prices, it is not good news that Trump and Republicans are making Americans hungrier.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
statements.title: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
sentences: I will not stand by while costs rise, rights are trampled, and working families are left behind.
I urge a ``no'' vote on this latest Republican budget betrayal.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MAKE AMERICA AFFORDABLE
statements.title: MAKE AMERICA AFFORDABLE
sentences: Working families don't feel Trump's economy in their hearts.
Trump's tariffs illegally took billions from American consumers for everyday goods, and he won't give a dime back.
Instead of fighting an unlawful war in Iran, they should be focused on lowering costs here at home.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COMMEMORATING THE LIFE AND LEGACY OF THE REVEREND JESSE LOUIS JACKSON, SR.
statements.title: COMMEMORATING THE LIFE AND LEGACY OF THE REVEREND JESSE LOUIS JACKSON, SR.
sentences: Your mission lives on, however, in each one of us, and we will carry it forward with courage, with justice, and yes, of course, hope.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: UNAUTHORIZED WAR IS RECKLESS
statements.title: UNAUTHORIZED WAR IS RECKLESS
sentences: Yet instead of focusing on the needs of the American people, Trump started a war of choice with Iran.
Iran cannot have a nuclear weapon, and the Iranian people deserve self-determination.
I have voted yes on the War Powers Resolution to stop Trump from further destabilizing the Middle East, to prevent more casualties, and to stop this madness.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ROTORCRAFT OPERATIONS TRANSPARENCY AND OVERSIGHT REFORM ACT
statements.title: ROTORCRAFT OPERATIONS TRANSPARENCY AND OVERSIGHT REFORM ACT
sentences: For the Lane family, for the 67 lives lost and their families, for every passenger and crew member in our skies, I urge a ``yes'' vote.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENTS TO H.R. 7148, CONSOLIDATED APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.J. RES. 142, DISAPPROVING THE
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENTS TO H.R. 7148, CONSOLIDATED APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.J. RES. 142, DISAPPROVING THE ACTION OF THE DISTRICT OF...
sentences: Instead of lowering costs, Republicans poured billions into DHS, an agency spreading chaos and making choices with deadly consequences, all while ignoring the needs of working families.
Mr. Speaker, everyone in this Chamber has a chance to decide today: Do we want to lower costs and protect 700,000 Americans receiving Medicaid or fund Trump's domestic mass army of terror?
Democrats and Republicans agreed that we should cut the ICE slush fund to protect Medicaid.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REMOTE ACCESS SECURITY ACT
statements.title: REMOTE ACCESS SECURITY ACT
sentences: President Biden took steps to prevent the remote access of U.S. chips by our adversaries in his Artificial Intelligence Diffusion Rule.

For the sake of enriching himself and his billionaire friends, Trump went further to undermine our national security by loosening President Biden's export controls on advanced chip sales to build data centers in Saudi Arabia and the UAE.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 2683, as amended.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF VICTIMS OF BROWN UNIVERSITY MASS SHOOTING
statements.title: MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF VICTIMS OF BROWN UNIVERSITY MASS SHOOTING
sentences: As law enforcement continues their work, we thank them for their efforts and wish them strength in their pursuit to bring to justice whoever committed this horrific act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: INCREASING COSTS OF THANKSGIVING
statements.title: INCREASING COSTS OF THANKSGIVING
sentences: Americans simply cannot afford to live in Trump's economy--not my constituents expecting their healthcare costs to more than double next year, and not small business owners and consumers alike hit hard by tariffs.
Americans are hurting because my colleagues across the aisle would rather give tax breaks to billionaires than lower costs for working families.
Whether someone calls it stuffing or dressing, cranberry relish or sauce, I will keep working for them to lower their costs and make life affordable. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent to amend the rule to make in order the amendment at the desk that protects against any cuts to Medicaid and SNAP.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: It will be at the hands of Republicans who vote ``yes.'' The top 1 percent are salivating over getting an extra $300,000 a year because of this dangerous bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RHODE ISLAND STATE POLICE CENTENARY
statements.title: RHODE ISLAND STATE POLICE CENTENARY
sentences: Mr. Speaker, with admiration and appreciation, I wish to recognize the 100th anniversary of the Rhode Island State Police.

On April 2, 1925 the Rhode Island General Assembly created the ``Rhode Island Department of State Police.'' It was the first such organization in our state dedicated to ensuring safety, order, and security for Rhode Islanders.
What began with just 21 officers patrolling on Indian-brand motorcycles has grown into a modern, technologically advanced law enforcement agency committed to the highest standards of public service.
Over the course of the agency's esteemed 100 year history, the dedicated men and women of the Rhode Island State Police have worked tirelessly to ensure Rhode Islanders' safety.
And I know that for the next one hundred years they will continue to serve justice, help stranded motorists, and keep our communities safe.

As they mark their centenary during national law enforcement week, I join every Rhode Islander in thanking the Troopers of the Rhode Island State Police for their 100 years of public service. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: They value making the rich richer, the sick sicker, the hungry hungrier, and, yes, the poor poorer.
It is a moral inversion, a reverse Robin Hood scheme, to steal from the poor and give to the rich.
This big, bad bill is an abomination that will hurt tens of thousands of Rhode Islanders just to give billionaires a break on their taxes.
You have my word that I will never stop fighting for vulnerable Rhode Islanders and against this dangerous bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: I STAND WITH THE DISABILITY COMMUNITY
statements.title: I STAND WITH THE DISABILITY COMMUNITY
sentences: Pranoy lives with Down syndrome and uses an adaptive communication device with specialized software to communicate, paid for by Medicaid.
Yet, Republicans are trying to ram through their disastrous budget poised to gut Medicaid and threaten healthcare for one in four Rhode Islanders.
These Republican Medicaid cuts would hinder Pranoy's potential.

I stand with the disability community, and I will stand against any attempt to rip away Medicaid from children who deserve the same opportunity to flourish as any other American, to live out their potential and flourish. ____________________
I am standing here today because I stand with Pranoy.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRUMP'S FIRST 100 DAYS
statements.title: TRUMP'S FIRST 100 DAYS
sentences: He has failed to keep Americans safe.

Surely, when we see cancer research funding eliminated, when 2-year-old citizens are deported, when the budget resolution calls for the largest proposed cut to Medicaid ever, surely, we can say these things are wrong, no?

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
statements.title: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
sentences: They refused in February when they spiked my amendments to support Medicaid and SNAP, and they refused again today.

This is despite the pleas of Americans protesting Donald Trump and Republicans' plan to steal their healthcare and let kids go hungry and despite the overwhelming majority crying out for everyday Americans over the whims of billionaires.
Al needs Medicare and Medicaid to make ends meet.
It is not fear-mongering to say that Republicans' plans would hurt Al to prop up billionaires.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SPEAKING TRUTH TO POWER
statements.title: SPEAKING TRUTH TO POWER
sentences: We also know they have their sights on Social Security and Medicare, per Elon Musk's statement that it is the ``big one'' to cut.
I will start with a constituent of mine from Barrington, Rhode Island, who works in international development.
The way she explains it: ``Eliminating USAID in its entirety has hollowed out what used to be the largest bilateral aid agency in the world.
They lose access to shelter, medical care, clean water, food, and education.'' Cuts to U.S. foreign aid have forced the nonprofit to start laying off people.

Worse still, because of potential cuts to Medicaid that Republicans are pursuing in their budget resolution, she is worried whether her family, including her two young sons, will have health insurance if she loses her job.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
statements.title: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
sentences: It threatens third graders in my hometown of Pawtucket who rely on the community eligibility provision to eat school breakfast and lunch.
It threatens a new mom on Aquidneck Island who needs Medicaid to afford postpartum care.
It threatens seniors in East Providence who depend on Medicaid's home- and community-based services to stay connected to their loved ones as they age at home.
To pay for tax cuts for the rich.

The Republican plan could slash $230 billion from SNAP and $880 billion from Medicaid, two proposals which allow them to turn around and shovel $1.1 trillion in tax giveaways to the richest 1 percent.
Republicans also refused to join me in supporting Medicaid.
Republicans are putting the needs of billionaires above the needs of ordinary Americans.
